rule_sources: health/policies/qualification-rules.md#Rule Q5: Required fields for a qualified lead

details.premium_note: floater premium not in provided material; advisor sends written quote

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Hello, this is Asha, a virtual assistant from Suraksha Health Insurance, calling about the health insurance enquiry you submitted. This call is recorded for quality and training purposes. Is this a good time to talk for about five minutes?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: First, who would you like to cover: just yourself, or also your spouse, children or parents?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: What is the age of the eldest person to be covered?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Which city do you live in?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Does anyone to be covered have an existing medical condition, such as diabetes, blood pressure, thyroid or asthma?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Honestly this is too expensive, I can't afford it

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: I understand, budget matters. One hospital stay can cost several lakh rupees, and your premium stays fixed for the year. We can look at a lower cover amount, a single family floater instead of separate policies, a 10% family discount when two or more members are covered, or monthly auto-debit payments. Does anyone to be covered have an existing medical condition, such as diabetes, blood pressure, thyroid or asthma?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Do you have any existing health insurance, including cover from your employer?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My company already gives me health insurance

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: That is good to have. Employer cover usually stops when you change jobs or retire, and it is often shared or limited. A personal policy lets you finish the waiting periods while you are still employed, or you can add a Super Top-Up on top of your office cover. Do you have any existing health insurance, including cover from your employer?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Last one: which cover amount are you looking at, 5, 10, 15 or 25 lakh rupees? You can also say not sure.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: That's fine, we can leave that for the advisor. Thank you, that's everything I need. You're eligible to apply for Family Shield. Please note: illnesses are covered after a 30-day waiting period, and pre-existing diseases after 3 years. I'll send you a written quote by email or WhatsApp within 15 minutes, and an advisor will confirm the final premium. Thank you for your time, goodbye.
